page: Google Cloud Platform c4-standard-144-lssd is a compute-optimized server instance powered by an Intel Xeon 6985P-C processor. It features 144 vCPUs across 72 physical cores with hyper-threading enabled, running at a clock speed of 2.3 GHz. The system is equipped with 540.0 GB of dedicated RAM, providing a memory-to-core ratio of 3.75 GB per core. For local storage, it bundles 24 NVMe SSDs totaling 9383 GB of high-speed local capacity.

Benchmark data places this instance in the top tier for multi-core CPU performance, software compilation, ray tracing, and encryption. The Intel Xeon architecture supports advanced instruction sets including AVX-512 and Intel Advanced Matrix Extensions, which contribute to its top-tier performance in LLM prompt processing and text generation. Memory bandwidth is highly efficient, with read-only and write-only large block transfers scoring in the top 10%. Single-core performance is moderate, placing in the middle 50% for stress-ng tests.

Given its high density of dedicated compute resources and massive local NVMe storage, this instance offers high qualitative resource density for data-intensive workloads. It is highly suited for large-scale database operations, high-throughput Redis deployments, static web serving, and multi-threaded decompression tasks. The lack of a GPU is offset by strong CPU-based machine learning inference capabilities, making it a viable option for CPU-bound LLM workloads and complex data processing pipelines.
